title: MAINT: add named constants for USB class 0x0B and endpoint direction bit 0x80
description: wp11_ccid.c uses 0x0Bu (CCID USB class code) and 0x80u (IN endpoint direction bit) as raw magic numbers. A contributor copying this code without USB spec knowledge would not know what these mean. Fix: add at top of wp11_ccid.c: #define WP11_USB_CLASS_CCID 0x0Bu  /* USB class code for CCID/smartcard readers */ and #define WP11_USB_EP_DIR_IN 0x80u  /* USB endpoint address IN direction bit */. Use these constants in the endpoint discovery loop.
